pages.title: What is supported
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Create$(): zinc ore and deepslate zinc ore, and the zinc ingot grinds like copper. Any Create works, including Create Fabric and Create Fly.$(li)$(thing)Seamless Ores$(): every vanilla ore restyled into andesite, diorite, granite and tuff, plus blackstone and basalt variants for the nether ores.$(li)$(thing)Universal Ores$(): the same idea in its own namespace.

pages.title: If a mod is missing
pages.text: Nothing breaks when one of those is absent. Their ores are matched by name, so an id that is not registered simply never matches anything.$(br2)Wider support that picks up $(thing)any$() ore mod through the common ore tags is planned.
